name: Sunny Yuen
description: Self-sovereign AI agent representing this professional's canonical profile. Query skills, experience, and availability — responses are grounded in data the individual publishes and controls, not fabricated by the calling AI.

extensions.description: Protocol bindings supported by this agent (MCP, HTTP+JSON).
Custom API documentation, rate limits, and contact metadata.

skills.name: Query Profile
skills.description: Ask natural language questions about this candidate's skills, experience, and background. Answers are grounded in project observations and lived experience, not just resume bullets — behavioral and decision-making questions draw on the candidate's own captured notes about how and why they built things.
examples: What is your experience with TypeScript?
How do you decide what features to build?
Walk me through a hard engineering tradeoff you made.

skills.name: Job Match
skills.description: Score this candidate against a job description and return a fit breakdown.
examples: Senior frontend engineer, React, TypeScript, 5+ years.

skills.name: Profile Info
skills.description: Returns full profile data including skills, employment, education, and projects.

skills.name: Availability
skills.description: Returns current availability status and preferred roles.

skills.name: Portfolio Projects
skills.description: Returns all portfolio projects with tech stack, highlights, and architecture.
